votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of February 18, 2025 and June 3, 2025.
votes.description: Approval of the official formal meeting minutes from two prior Council sessions.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 32 of 2025 recognizing October as Italian-American Heritage Month.
votes.description: Ceremonial resolution recognizing the cultural, civic, and historical contributions of Italian Americans and acknowledging their legacy in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and move items B-1 through B-4 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing on four grant applications (City Creek Daylighting, Cybercrime Law Enforcement, Jordan River Water Trail, and Jordan River Corridor Improvement) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 63 of 2025, Text Amendment to Modify Residential Buffer Prohibitions.
votes.description: Adopts a zoning text amendment to Title 21A reviewing and clarifying which land uses are subject to 1,000-foot residential buffer prohibitions and how distances are measured.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and continue it to a future Council meeting (Utility Installation Exemptions Text Amendment).
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on the proposed utility installation exemptions text amendment to allow time to address Council requests regarding park exemptions and design standards.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 64 of 2025, Patriot Rail Street Vacations.
votes.description: Closes portions of unbuilt public right-of-way at approximately 6500 West Interstate 80 Eastbound Freeway to allow the Salt Lake Garfield & Western Railway to purchase the land for railroad-related uses.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and approve Ordinance 65 of 2025, adopting items A-2 (National League of Cities Summit Costs), A-6 (Modification of Appointed Position and Police Department), and A-11 (Assistance for Airport Federal Partners Due to Government Shutdown), deferring action on remaining items to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Partially adopts FY 2025-26 Budget Amendment No. 2, approving three specific line items while deferring the remaining budget amendment items for future Council consideration.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing (2026-2027 HUD General Community Development Needs Annual Public Hearing).
votes.description: Closes the annual public hearing required by HUD to gather community input on development needs to prioritize CDBG, ESG, HOME, and HOPWA grant funds.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing (203 West Paxton Avenue Affordable Housing Development TEFRA hearing).
votes.description: Closes the TEFRA public hearing required by federal regulations for the Pax Station Apartment tax-exempt private activity bond; no further Council action is required.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 33 of 2025, Substantial Amendment to the HOME-ARP Allocation Plan, to relocate a portion of one-time HUD HOME-ARP funding.
votes.description: Reallocates $230,306 in HUD HOME-ARP funds from Tenant-Based Rental Assistance to Supportive Services to enable contracted organizations to provide case management for assisted households.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 66 of 2025, vacating the 1100 West street segment and denying vacating the 400 South street segment adjacent to the applicant's property at 1101 West 400 South.
votes.description: Partially approves a street vacation request, closing only the 1100 West portion of the right-of-way to facilitate construction of a single-family residence while denying the 400 South portion.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 67 of 2025, approving a $40,000 loan for Rich's Grub Houses LLC, doing business as Rich's Burgers N Grub, from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: Approves a $40,000 EDLF loan to an existing restaurant at 30 East Broadway to fund equipment and leasehold improvements and support job creation and retention.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 34 of 2025, approving the 2025 Salt Lake County Hazard Mitigation Plan.
votes.description: Approves the federally required five-year update to the hazard mitigation plan, maintaining Salt Lake City's eligibility for FEMA pre-disaster and post-disaster assistance funds.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 35 of 2025 to approve the Salt Lake City Central HTRZ Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency.
votes.description: Authorizes an interlocal agreement to share tax increment between the City and the CRA for the Salt Lake Central Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone as required by state code.

Approves setting public hearing dates for two ordinances (RMF-35/45 zoning and Wildland Urban Interface Fire Code) and confirms four board appointments (Transportation Advisory Board, City and County Building Conservancy and Use Committee, Art Design Board, Historic Landmark Commission).
